purpose: Narrow, source-backed Nigerian enrichment for the residual canonical roles that survived placement cleanup. These profiles add evidence for the role family; they do not claim universal demand, salary, licensing eligibility or an exact employer title.

sources.name: NBTE agricultural equipment and implement mechanics curriculum
sources.scope: Nigerian agricultural equipment mechanics training, including agricultural mechanisation, tractor systems, repair, maintenance and workshop safety
findings: NBTE publishes Agricultural Equipment Mechanics NOS/NSQ pathways and an Agricultural Equipment and Implement Mechanics work curriculum.
The curriculum includes agricultural mechanisation, tractors, equipment repair and maintenance, workshop practice and safety controls.
sources.limitations: A national technical curriculum establishes a Nigerian training route, not a universal employer requirement or a guarantee of work in every agricultural or heavy-equipment setting.

sources.name: National Postgraduate Medical College of Nigeria neurology subspecialty curriculum
sources.scope: Nigerian postgraduate neurology specialist training and clinical practice preparation
findings: The National Postgraduate Medical College of Nigeria publishes a Neurology Sub-Specialty training curriculum.
MDCN materials separately establish Nigerian medical registration and additional postgraduate-qualification registration boundaries.
sources.limitations: The curriculum supports a specialist pathway; it does not state that every neurologist follows one identical appointment route or that a postgraduate qualification alone substitutes for MDCN registration.
